-        prev = idx

+        prev = idx
+        a = chr(p0)
+        b = chr(p1)
+        app((a + b, chr(idx), a, b))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Same as s.replace(ps, c) for every (ps, c, a, b) of a _replace_table, in
+    order. present is a superset of the code points in s (the initial ones
+    plus every c actually minted), so a pair with a token not in it cannot
+    occur and its replace (a full scan of s that changes nothing) is skipped.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            t = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if t is not s:
+                add(c)
+                s = t
+    return s
